turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Hello? Hi. Um, should we start? Yeah, okay. Hello how um. Good morning sir, how can I help you this morning?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Hello, how are you? Oh hey, um, I've just had some diarrhea for the last three days, um, and it's been affecting me I need to stay close to the toilet. And, um, yeah, it's been affecting my day-to-day activities.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: [inaudible] Sorry to hear that. Um, and and when you say diarrhea, what'd you mean by diarrhea? Do you mean you're going to the toilet more often? Or are your stools more loose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so it's like loose and watery stool, going to the toilet quite often, uh and like some pain in my, like, lower stomach?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And how many times a day are you going, let's say, in the last couple of days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, probably like six or seven times a day? Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Six, seven times a day. And you [inaudible] mention it's mainly watery. Have you noticed any other things, like blood in your stools?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no blood, yeah, just watery and loose stool.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And you mentioned you've had some pain in your tummy as well. [inaudible] Whereabouts is the pain, exactly?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yep. So [inaudible] in my lower abdomen, so, uh, like, um...yeah, just to one side.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: One side. And what side is that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, on the left side.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Left side. Okay, and can you describe the pain to me?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, it feels, um, like a cramp, like a muscular cramp, and, um, yeah i feel a bit uh weak and shaky.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And is the pain, is that, is it there all the time, or does it come and go?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, it comes and goes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Come and go. Does the pain move anywhere else, for example towards your back?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh...no, just maybe my stomach.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, fine. And you mentioned you've been feeling quite weak and shaky as well. What do you mean by shaky? Do you mean you've been having, uh have you been feeling feverish, for example?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah. Um, yeah, it doesn't feel like -- yeah, it just makes me feel weak. I haven't had a fever, um, at the moment, but I did notice um a temperature when the symptoms started, so, um, yeah around about three or four days ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You measure your temperature then?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I uh I didn't mention my temperature, no, but I felt, um, just a bit hot. And, y'know.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Okay. Any other symptoms like sweating, or um, night sweats? No? And, uh, any vomiting at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no. Yeah, so um, I vomited at the start of the symptoms but now um I've stopped vomiting.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You stopped vomiting, okay. And was your vomit, I know it's not a nice thing to talk about, but was it just normal food colour [inaudible] Yeah. And there was no blood in your vomit, is that right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, just normal vomit, yeah. No no blood, no. Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, okay. Um, and um, any any other symptoms at all? So you mentioned tummy pain, you mentioned diarrhea, you mentioned your vomiting, uh, anything else that comes to mind?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yep. Um, I had a loss of appetite, um, so I haven't been eating as much, but I've been able to hold down fluids.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: [inaudible] Okay. Okay, so you're drinking fluids. Um, what kind of foods have you managed to eat, if anything?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yep. Um, just soups, and, uh, yeah, light foods. Like smoothies and, yeah, liquid foods mainly.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Fine. Um, and sir [inaudible] these started three days ago the symptoms. Are you aware of any triggers which may have caused the symptoms uh to kick on. So for example, think like takeaway foods or eating out or being around other people with similar symptoms.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I had takeaway about four days ago, um, uh, but other than that I've, yeah, been, uh, eating normally. Nothing unusual here.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Do you remember where you ate?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, I [inaudible] ate at a Chinese restaurant with friends. Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Anyone else unwell with similar symptoms?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, so no one else in the family, so [inaudible] a wife and two kids and one, um, child was vomiting, but they haven't got diarrhea. There's no one with the same symptoms.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, okay. Fine. Um, alright. And uh, in terms of your [inaudible] , your overall health, are you normally fit and well? Or, uh

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, I mean, other than um athsma, um I use an inhaler, everything uh else is fine.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. And, is your asthma well-controlled?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah, that's fine. I just, yeah, use an inhaler, and uh that's under control.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Fine. And you don't have any other tummy problem, bowel problems I should be aware of?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, okay. Um, and [inaudible] apart from the inhalers, do you take any other medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, no other medications.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, fine. And in terms of just your day to day life, you said it's been affecting your life, um, in what way has it been affecting your life?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah. Uh, so, I need to stay close to the toilet 'cause I go quite frequently during the these past three days. Um, yeah, other than that, it's uh, yeah, the main concern.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. Yeah. And have you, are you currently working at the moment? [inaudible]

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yes, yeah. I I work, er. Um, I'm an accountant.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Would, would work. Okay. Have you been going into work the last three days, or have you been at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah, I've been going to work. Yeah. Yeah, it's been quite difficult.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: [inaudible] okay. That must be difficult for you then. [inaudible] fine. And you said, you mentioned you live with your wife and two children, is that right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Right, alright. Um, just a couple of other question we need to ask, sir. Um, do you smoke at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, I don't smoke.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And do you drink much in the way of alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, I I don't drink alcohol, no. [inaudible]

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay. [inaudible] so um, er normally at this stage I like to um, examine you if that's okay, but um, um, but but having listened to your story, sir, I think uh, um, just to recap [inaudible] for the last three days you've been having loose stool, diarrhea, a bit of tummy pain uh mainly on the left-hand side, um and [inaudible] vomiting and fever and you're quite weak and lethargic um, you mentioned you had this Chinese takeaway as little as three days ago and I wondered whether that might be the cause of your problems.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah. Okay.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, it seems like you may have something, uh, called gastroenteritis, which essentially just a tummy bug or infection of your uh of your tummy. Uh, mainly caused by viruses but there can be a possibility of bacteria uh causing its symptoms. Um.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah. Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: At this stage, uh, what, what we'd recommend is just what we say conservative management. So, um, I don't think you need anything like antibiotics. It's really just, um, making sure you're well hydrated, so drinking fluids.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Mm-hmm.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, [inaudible] there are things like Dioralyte you can get from the pharmacy, which uh it's um it helps helps replenish your minerals and vitamins.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, and if you are having vomiting diarrhea I would say recommend that in the first, you know, first couple of days.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yep.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: [inaudible] If you are feeling feverish and weak, eh taking some paracetamol, uh, [inaudible] two tablets up to four times a day for the first few days can also help.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yep.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I will certainly advise you to take some time off work, actually I know you're quite keen to work but I would say the next two, two to three days as the infection clears from your system to take some time off and rest.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay. Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, I'll admit if your symptoms haven't got better, you know, in in three to four days, I'd like to come and see you again. [inaudible]

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay, sure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Because if it is ongoing then we have to wonder whether something else caused your symptoms.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yep.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uh, and we may need to do further tests like um taking a sample of your stool so we can test that. Um, etcetera etcetera.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yep, sure, yep.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: How's that sound?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: That sounds great, yeah. Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: [inaudible] Do you have any questions for me?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no, no further questions, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Okay, and is uh is the treatment plan clear?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yes, yeah, that's that's very clear. Thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Great. Well, I wish you all the best.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Okay, thank you. Bye.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: [inaudible] Thank you. Bye bye.
